🚨 ▸ WARNING: This game contains flashing lights and jumpscares! 
🖥️📱🎮 ▸ Supports PC, Mobile & Console 
---------------------------------------------
For the best experience.
📈 Turn on max graphics.
🎧 Use Headphones
------------------
Controls:

C / B - Crouch
Shift / Lt - Run
Q / E - Peaking
F - Unlock mouse
------------------
3.0 update summary:

Brand new lobby
45 unique threats to try to survive
1990 house
Portals to legacy and 2.0 behind shop
Frequent patches and updates
Shifting towards a scarier feel
Custom night gamepass (control anything)
Peaking around corners to spot inmates
Tasks
New shop
New items and upgrades
Reworked some inmate models
Inmates can now enter through windows
Inmates can now hear you
Broadcaster now stalks you
